title: Prevent Git maintenance from racing source-history fixture cleanup
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #4963's [registered-package planner](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39899746058/job/120238338830) fails during temporary Git repository cleanup after `test_metadata_shape_and_resource_bounds`: `OSError: [Errno 39] Directory not empty: '/tmp/tmp0i86qfs3/.git'`. Package replay never starts. This is a shared test-fixture failure, separate from the submitted PG29 mathematics.

Disable automatic Git maintenance and GC only on commands issued by `SourceHistoryTests.git`. Real Git 2.55 Trace2 records show 34 maintenance children from the original twelve-test suite and none from the repaired thirteen-test suite. A regression forces automatic work, rejects the unguarded helper, and requires a synchronous positive-control commit to start maintenance. It does not ignore cleanup failures or alter history-validation assertions.

The historical `isolated-descendant-bytecode` replay authenticates this test from `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` and copies those original bytes into `actual_history.py`. It never imports the live test. Its source row therefore changes only from `usage: input` to `usage: provenance`. The base commit, Git blob `9c52884a4663c089e2331b769b50d14da4575d9f`, SHA256 `2b974b7c1f5fcb1994c2b76be32554378cec91871224fca0af011d0640dc5514` and every other pin remain unchanged. The current test remains a declared `VERIFY.json` input for replay selection and committed-byte checks.

Four source-bound regression groups check this distinction: an unimportable live test cannot replace the original pinned historical test; the old live-input role rejects the compatible guard; corruption of the old blob or SHA still rejects; and changing the live test still selects its package and fails uncommitted-byte publication checks. The original verifier, all three commands, task and result bytes are unchanged. No mathematical source, selected result or scientific claim changes.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-assigned failed-workflow repair, based on canonical main `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`. Scope unchanged. #4857 previously repaired the same maintenance lifecycle in the sparse-baseline fixture; this is the separate source-history fixture demonstrated by #4963's actual failure.

Current guidance and the delta-only intake procedure were read. Its refresh fetched canonical main, but queue planning cannot read GitHub because `gh` is absent. Targeted connector reads and the all-author PR monitor establish current heads and ownership instead. No queue or scientific acceptance decision is made.

This does not duplicate jwr404's active #4973 PYTHONPATH work, JoyboyBrian's #4975 SIGTERM handling, the external #4968 census optimization, or existing starting-head reconciliation repairs.

## Validation

Linux, Python 3.12.3, Git 2.55.0. Hosted failure: Python 3.12.15, Git 2.55.0.

```sh
python3 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_source_history.py -v
python3 -W error -B -O -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_source_history.py -v
python3 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_descendant_source_roles.py -v
python3 -W error -B -O -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_descendant_source_roles.py -v
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py' -v
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode --check-source-history
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --changed-since b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15 --explain-plan /tmp/source-history-plan.json
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode --ref HEAD --output /tmp/source-history-fixture-export.tar.gz
PATH=/nonexistent /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/source-history-fixture-export.tar.gz
```

Both focused source-history suites pass thirteen tests; both source-role suites pass ten tests. The original three-command registered package replay passes with its existing `partial` outcome. The full helper suite passes 367 tests with 11 expected platform skips (218.579 seconds). At commit `00026e07e9ad9192482402901f5895d10e59c6af`, committed-byte and source-history checks pass for all 13 declared package/input files, and the planner selects only `research/isolated-descendant-bytecode`. Official export and its Git-free integrity check pass; export SHA256 is `b0bd2f7fa8dc17736057fb036f51886b4d5a81d9cf8f8afc2faeaf5387aea40b`. The registered historical scientific replay requires Git; the Git-free check authenticates bundle transport only. [Hosted run39905307584](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39905307584) passed at that exact head on its first attempt. The actual planner ran367 helpers/11 expected skips, including the forced-maintenance and four source-role boundary controls, and selected only this package. Its unchanged three registered replay commands and committed-input integrity gate passed; historical outcome remains partial.

The comparison with a new live source pin was rejected: the unchanged historical verifier explicitly reads `base_commit:path` for every row and does not implement row-level successor-pin dispatch. Adding a same-path successor would either fail its original hash check or substitute different test bytes. The role correction preserves the original experiment and separately tests the live fixture.

## Credit

Retains Nick Petalas's source-history tests, Arham Tahir's historical bytecode differential and source credit, roger-sato's earlier source-role correction, and the existing isolated-runner lineage. Repair by Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing licence and attribution notices remain intact.

## Open next questions

[Required handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19138624). Exact-head upstream planner and the selected original historical replay now pass. Keep other fixture failures evidence-driven; no broad Git policy, source repinning, historical replay campaign or selected-frontier update is proposed.
